_doc: Single source of truth for fish species. fishmod/tools/gen_species.py generates include/fishmod_species_data.h (game) and fishmod/wiki/species/*.md (wiki) from this file. Lengths are inches, weights pounds. Behavior values are 0-100. 'base' picks the model: bass or loach (object_fish). 'shape' scales the model: [length, height, width]. 'tint' is the RGB primitive color the model is multiplied by. 'scenes' lists where the fish lives with a spawn weight; 'status' is 'in-game' once it actually spawns somewhere.

species.name: Greengill
species.flavor: A small, bright fish found in almost every pond and creek in Hyrule. It nibbles at anything that drifts by, which makes it the first catch of many young anglers.
species.tips: Bites readily, even without bait. Taps the bobber a couple of times before it commits.

species.name: Hyrule Bass
species.origin: Twilight Princess, Ocarina of Time (Fishing Pond)
species.flavor: The classic Hylian game fish. It hunts from cover and strikes hard, and the big ones are known to leap clear of the water to throw the hook.
species.tips: Most active around dawn and dusk. A twitched bobber or a live bug draws it out. Expect a jump when it is hooked.

species.name: Ordon Catfish
species.flavor: A whiskered bottom-feeder first described by the villagers of Ordon. It lurks in the deepest, muddiest part of a pond and pulls like a stubborn goat once hooked.
species.tips: Fish the deepest water after dark. It takes its time and nibbles several times before the real bite, then fights long but never jumps.

species.name: Hylian Loach
species.origin: Ocarina of Time (Fishing Pond), Twilight Princess
species.flavor: A long, spotted bottom-dweller that anglers whisper about. Young loaches turn up in quiet forest water now and then; the giants of legend are rarely seen anywhere.
species.tips: Extremely wary: cast well away from it and keep still. It nibbles a lot and the real bite is short.

species.name: Sanke Carp
species.flavor: An ornamental carp with red and white markings, kept in sacred waters since ancient times. The Kokiri say they swim in the forest for luck.
species.tips: Cruises near the surface on bright days. Curious, but picky: sweet bee larvae work best.

species.name: Hylian Pike
species.flavor: A lean ambush hunter of open water, famous as the star of jumping fish. It hits fast and spends half the fight in the air.
species.tips: No nibbles: when it goes for the bait, the bobber is gone. Ease off the reel when it jumps.

species.name: Reekfish
species.flavor: A red fish with a smell so strong it can be tracked by nose. It lives only near the Zoras' home and ignores ordinary bait.
species.tips: Only bites on the Coral Earring, a Zora heirloom.

species.name: Hearty Bass
species.flavor: A heavy, rosy bass said to give strength to whoever eats it. The biggest ones live in the deep water of Lake Hylia.
species.tips: Behaves like a big Hyrule Bass but pulls harder and longer.

species.name: Jabu-Jabu Fry
species.flavor: A tiny relative of Lord Jabu-Jabu, the Zoras' guardian deity. The Zoras consider it very lucky, and it is said to love eating fish.
species.tips: Hangs near the surface and is very curious. Legend says it prefers fish as bait.

baits.name: Bare hook
baits.notes: Fishing without bait works, but most fish are less interested.

baits.name: Bee Larva
baits.source: Knock down a beehive and scoop the larvae with an empty bottle (10 per scoop)

baits.name: Bug
baits.notes: Wriggling live bait that bass go for.

baits.name: Coral Earring
baits.notes: A Zora heirloom; the only thing a Reekfish will bite.
